brief.topic: Local-first code intelligence / code knowledge graph tools for AI coding agents: product positioning, technical architecture, and target users

criteria.question: What product problem does this project solve and what is its headline value proposition for AI coding agents?
What is the indexing/parsing/storage architecture (tree-sitter, vector embeddings, SQLite, Neo4j, in-browser), and which languages/frameworks are supported?
Who are the target users (which AI agents/IDEs are supported, individual developers vs teams, local-first vs cloud)?
What differentiates this project from alternatives (auto-sync, framework routes, cross-language bridging, visualization, semantic search)?
What is the project maturity (release cadence, documentation, benchmarks, ecosystem adoption)?
